fields.statement: QA at 7f99063: extracted the changes and check job scripts from .github/workflows/ci.yml and ran them in a scratch git repo. changes: a PR touching only .rhiza/ gives code=false (also when the base advanced on main after branching, via merge-base); a PR also touching main.go gives code=true; workflow_dispatch and push give code=true. check: [changes+model success, Go jobs skipped] exits 0; [model skipped, Go jobs success] exits 0; all skipped but changes exits 1; a failed Go job, a failed model job, a cancelled job, or a failed changes job each exit 1. Job graph parsed with PyYAML: model needs changes if code == 'false', lint/scripts/api/rest/budgets need changes if code == 'true', check needs all seven with always(). The model job's steps run locally with this commit's build: make self-check ok (with the session's own untracked actor log set aside) and go test -trimpath ./internal/op -run TestEveryFieldInRepoLogIsKnown ok; go test -trimpath ./internal/ciworkflow/... ok. main has no branch protection (gh api 404), so ship check is the gate. The post-merge observation of the next model-only PR's CI is not yet observable.

QA at 7f99063: go test -trimpath -count=1 ./internal/api -run 'ChecksVerdict|ShipRerunFailed|WatchdogCIRerun' ok, covering ModelOnlyPR (changes/model/check SUCCESS, the five Go jobs SKIPPED) as settled and green, TestShipRerunFailedSkippedJobs issuing no gh run rerun, and the TestWatchdogCIRerun model-only head with no rerun and rerunSpent false. Cross-checked with the real check-job script: the same skipped/success mix exits 0, so ship check and the workflow's aggregate agree.
